messages.content: Each word in your response must start with the next letter of the alphabet, looping back to 'A' after 'Z'. Transform the poetic stanza into a description for an anime.  We are the school idols, hearts on fire, Singing our stories, reaching higher. Together we shine, a symphony, In this dance of youth and melody.

message.content: An original animated series depicts five high school girls who form a pop group to pursue their dreams. They perform live concerts in various cities across Japan, gaining fame while balancing academics and personal relationships. The story focuses on friendship, sacrifice, and the joy of music, culminating in a national tournament where they finally achieve their goal of becoming top idols.
